source.name: CISI (Centre for Inventions and Scientific Information)

downloadMethod.method: bounded HTTPS GET via node:https; transparent fetch decoding is avoided so the archive bytes and SHA-256 are exact

source.irDatasets: CISI is absent from ir_datasets 0.4.0, 0.5.5, 0.5.11 and 0.6.3 (PyPI wheels checked) and from the master tree; https://ir-datasets.com/cisi.html returns HTTP 404. The Glasgow IDOM archive is the public upstream source named by CISI dataset descriptions.
source.license: No license is asserted here. The Glasgow page does not state one; do not redistribute the corpus without checking.

labelMapping.mapping: The Glasgow CISI.REL four-column layout lists relevant query/document pairs; the third and fourth columns are all zero placeholders. Presence is mapped to grade 1. No graded or negative human labels are invented.
labelMapping.unlisted: Documents not listed for a query are treated by the evaluator as grade 0. That is a benchmark convention, not a human judgment that they are irrelevant.

provenance.proxy: One CISI document is one evaluator passage. The human judgments are document-level; these are document retrieval metrics used as a document-level proxy, not passage-label judgments or conversational evaluation.
warnings: The CISI source text is not redistributed by this manifest; the dataset output contains it.
Do not publish the dataset unless the source licensing is clear.
This is a classic test collection, not a frozen corpus produced by the live Pi system.

reproduction.note: The prepare script also downloads and verifies the archive itself when --archive is omitted. The prepared dataset contains CISI source text and is intentionally not committed. This artifact contains derived metrics, rankings, IDs and provenance only; query text is omitted.

scope.corpus: one frozen index shared by all three methods; every query is judged over the same pool
scope.unjudged: passages without a human grade count as zero relevance
scope.recall: pooledRecall10 is relative to the human-judged pool, not recall over the web
scope.lexicalPRF: anchored corpus-derived lexical feedback, not the live contextual model assessment
scope.excluded: this ablation does not evaluate research policy, allocation, conversation or report quality
scope.judgments: all judgments are human-supplied input; this tool fabricates no results

notes: This is a retrieval ablation on a classic human-judged test collection, not an end-to-end live Pi run.
One CISI document is one passage. Human judgments are document-level; metrics are a document-level proxy, not passage-label or conversational evaluation.
The 76 native queries with positive judgments are used; the 36 native queries without human judgments are excluded and listed in provenance.exclusions.unjudgedQueryIds.
Documents not listed in CISI.REL count as zero by benchmark convention; they are not human-labelled irrelevant.
Exact-body alias 1440 was excluded in favour of canonical 234; its one judgment (query 44) was already present for 234 and was deduplicated. No qrel was silently dropped.
ir_datasets 0.4.0-0.6.3 and master do not contain CISI; https://ir-datasets.com/cisi.html returns 404. The Glasgow archive is the public upstream source.
